user_request: Critique agent for all four parameters; +1 improvement, -10 no improvement, total100
interpretation: Start at zero; sum four metric rewards across unique future declared experiments, capped at100. Negative balances remain visible. Separate from actual benchmark.
improvement_rule: Strict positive paired mean normalized skill gain over frozen incumbent, identical splits/seeds/calibration/full-panel scorer. Raw metric directions remain documented separately. A mean gain alone does not certify stability.
eligibility: Future predeclared scored experiments only; no retroactive rewards, repeated seeds, duplicate variants, changing comparison or proxy claims. Validity is assessed before reward.
promotion_rule: Original full-panel four-metric, temporal and >72 mean/lower-tail >=64-replicate readiness gates unchanged. Critiques must discuss uncertainty/tradeoffs even when reward is positive.
agents: Four critics completed on explicit user request. Routine future heartbeat review does not automatically authorize spawning agents.
